**r7 (round 4):** the carrier (CR) now extends past the 31 x 33 mm Ag105 footprint by two tabs, tab X toward the Teensy and
tab Y toward L-FC. A bonded foot supports the far end of each tab (FT1, FT2; A.7). The EVM and the EIB are unchanged in
function; both move onto one insulating EVM plate on the chassis (A.7, C EM23). Every fail-safe argument of r1-r6 holds
unchanged; the only EIB circuit change is the damping resistor R276 in series with E1 (A.5, B.6). The six round-4 questions
have these answers:

- Side, extent and support: tab X (x 48.70-65.00, y 56.30-68.30) and tab Y (x 17.70-37.56, y 67.14-76.00) give a
  1394.06 mm² r7 outline, and FT1 and FT2 carry the tab ends (H.23(a), H.23(i)).
- EVM on or beside the CR: no; the 88.90 x 88.90 mm EVM fits neither on the CR nor beside it on the MB, so the EVM plate
  stands past the MB +y edge (A.7, H.23(l)).
- EIB merge onto the CR: no; with the EVM 0.10-0.30 m from the CR edge, a merge would export the unbuffered ILIM_HIZ node,
  REGN, /CE and STAT, so the EIB stays (B.6, J.2 item 60).
- Layer count: the CR stays a 4-layer, 1.6 mm, double-sided board at 73.55 % top and 69.04 % bottom area use, against
  101.8-109.9 % single-sided (H.23(e)).
- Retired constraints: the footprint confinement, the r6 area budget, the named bottom keep-out and the MB power-copper shadow
  retire; the bottom clearance rule replaces the last two (A.7).
- Modifications: no EVM modification (EM) and no MB modification (PM) becomes unnecessary; the text of EM5 and EM23 changes,
  and PM0, PM1, PM3, PM4, PM6 and PM7 gain r7 steps (C, D.1).

The r7 outline is not frozen before the operator survey T-A-08 (MS1-MS8) passes. MS2 decides the EVM placement and the W-lead
maxima (A.3, A.7).
